lines.beaver_en: Welcome. What brings you in today?
lines.learner: 한 달 넘게 감기를 앓고 있어요.
lines.en: I've been sick with a cold for over a month.
lines.roman: han dal neomge gamgireul alko isseoyo.

lines.beaver_en: A month? Is the pain bad?
lines.learner: 네, 온몸이 쑤시고 목에 통증이 있어요.
lines.en: Yes, my whole body aches and my throat hurts.
lines.roman: ne, onmomi ssusigo moge tongjeungi isseoyo.

lines.learner: 피부가 가려워서 밤에 도무지 잠을 못 자요.
lines.en: My skin itches, so I just can't sleep at night.
lines.roman: pibuga garyeowoseo bame domuji jameul mot jayo.

lines.beaver_en: Not sleeping must make you very tired.
lines.learner: 네, 잠을 못 자다 보니 너무 지쳤어요.
lines.en: Yes, not sleeping so long has worn me out.
lines.roman: ne, jameul mot jada boni neomu jichyeosseoyo.

lines.beaver_en: Have you taken any medicine so far?
lines.en: I tried to bear it, so I didn't take any.

lines.beaver_en: You held out too long. Did you take time off work?
lines.learner: 아니요, 일이 많다 보니까 쉬지 못했어요.
lines.en: No, with so much work, I couldn't rest.
lines.roman: aniyo, iri manta bonikka swiji motaesseoyo.

lines.beaver: 그래서 몸이 더 약해진 것 같아요.
lines.beaver_en: That seems to have weakened your body more.
lines.beaver_roman: geuraeseo momi deo yakaejin geot gatayo.
lines.learner: 이러다 큰 병이 될까 봐 여간 걱정이 아니에요.
lines.en: I'm really worried it'll turn into something serious.
lines.roman: ireoda keun byeongi doelkka bwa yeogan geokjeongi anieyo.

lines.beaver: 검사를 해 보면 원인이 밝혀질 거예요.
lines.beaver_en: A test will reveal the cause.
lines.beaver_roman: geomsareul hae bomyeon wonini balkyeojil geoyeyo.
lines.en: All the symptoms came at once, so it's so hard.

lines.beaver: 걱정 마세요. 약 먹고 푹 쉬면 나아질 거예요.
lines.beaver_en: Don't worry. With medicine and rest, you'll get better.
lines.beaver_roman: geokjeong maseyo. yak meokgo puk swimyeon naajil geoyeyo.
lines.en: Okay, this time I'll make sure to rest.

lines.beaver: 가려운 곳은 긁지 마시고 일주일 뒤에 오세요.
lines.beaver_en: Don't scratch the itchy spots, and come back in a week.
lines.beaver_roman: garyeoun goseun geukji masigo iljuil dwie oseyo.
lines.en: Thank you, doctor. I'll come back in a week.
